### Review skipped — opt-out keyword in branch name 🛑

The source branch `feature/noergloff-thing` contains the opt-out keyword `noergloff`, so the auto-review was skipped. No LLM or Jira calls were made for this PR.

**What to do**
- Rename the branch to remove the keyword and push again; the next webhook event will trigger a full review.
- Or @mention the bot explicitly in a comment if you want a one-off review on this branch — mentions are not muted.

**Configure**
- The keyword is set via `REVIEW_OPT_OUT_BRANCH_KEYWORD` on the noergler service (empty string disables the feature).
agents_missing:
### Review skipped — no `AGENTS.md` found 🛑

This repository has no `AGENTS.md` on the PR branch or the target branch. Project-specific review guidelines are **vital** for producing targeted, high-signal feedback — without them the reviewer falls back to generic nits, so the review was not run.

**What to do**
- Add an `AGENTS.md` file to the repository root describing project conventions, forbidden patterns, and areas the reviewer should focus on.
- Push the file to the PR branch (or merge it into the target branch) and the next webhook event on this PR will trigger a full review.

**Opt-out**
- To review PRs without an `AGENTS.md`, set `require_agents_md: false` for this team in the noergler `teams.yaml` (or `REVIEW_REQUIRE_AGENTS_MD=false` as the instance default) and restart.
diff_too_large:
### Review skipped — diff too large 🛑

The PR diff exceeds 10 MiB, more than fits in one review even after compression, so the review was not run.

**What to do**
- Split the change into smaller PRs, or move generated files, vendored code and lockfile churn into their own PR.
- Push the smaller change and the next webhook event on this PR will trigger a full review.
agents_too_large_nolink:
### Review skipped — `AGENTS.md` too large 🛑

`AGENTS.md` weighs in at ~12'345 tokens, exceeding the configured hard limit of 7'000 tokens. Oversized agent instructions crowd out the actual diff, degrade review quality (context rot), and inflate inference cost — so the review was not run.

**What to do**
- Trim `AGENTS.md`: drop sections that are there for humans to skim, remove duplicated README content, replace prose with terse rules.
- Move detailed reference material into separate files and link to them; keep the main file lean.
- Push the slimmer file and the next webhook event on this PR will trigger a full review.

**Configure**
- Raise the limit via `REVIEW_AGENTS_MD_MAX_TOKENS` on the noergler service, or set it to `0` to disable the hard cut-off entirely (the soft warning via `REVIEW_AGENTS_MD_WARN_TOKENS` remains).

**Further reading**
- [Upsun — The research is in: your AGENTS.md is probably too long (2026-02-23)](https://developer.upsun.com/posts/ai/agents-md-less-is-more)
- [Augment Code — A good AGENTS.md is a model upgrade. A bad one is worse than no docs at all (2026-04-22)](https://www.augmentcode.com/blog/how-to-write-good-agents-dot-md-files)
- [Caveman — Claude Code skill, "why use many token when few token do trick"](https://github.com/juliusbrussee/caveman)
